lines.text: Many learners say: I very like music.
Better: I like music very much.
Very goes after: like it very much.
Like very much! I like it very much.

data.why: Very goes after: like it very much.

native.tip: very 不能直接放在 like 前面，要说 “like ... very much”。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I very like music.”？😅 英语里 very 不修饰动词，要把 very much 放在句尾：“I like music very much.”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: Very cannot go before a verb. Say “like ... very much”.
en.caption: Do you say “I very like music.”? 😅 In English, very does not describe a verb, so put “very much” at the end: “I like music very much.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
